notes: V8 is built as a shared library (rusty_v8.dll + import lib) WITH its own bundled libc++ -- use_custom_libcxx stays on. An earlier plan set it false so V8 and Skia would share the MSVC STL, and this lock recorded that; it was measured infeasible on 2026-07-24 (clang-cl crashes on 32 torque-generated translation units, preceded by 78 -Wctad-maybe-unsupported errors, because Chromium compiles them with -D_HAS_EXCEPTIONS=0 and /std:c++23preview, which Microsoft's STL does not support). The Skia/V8 std::terminate collision is instead answered by the shared-library form keeping V8's libc++ internal. Note use_custom_libcxx is a cargo feature, not a GN argument: build.rs derives the GN value from CARGO_FEATURE_USE_CUSTOM_LIBCXX and overrides EXTRA_GN_ARGS, so it is recorded under cargo_features. component_kind, gn_args and cargo_features are Windows-specific extensions to the migo-v8-build-lock/v1 shape used by android-v8.lock.json.

required_patches.notes: Use bindgen 0.72.1's Clang 22+ declaration cursor fix.
Adds the host-callback registration surface rusty_v8 does not expose; the Windows DLL boundary needs it because the callbacks are registered from Rust rather than linked in.
Builds rusty_v8 as a shared library so V8 keeps its own bundled libc++ internal, which is what answers the Skia/V8 std::terminate collision recorded in this lock's notes.
Registers the host callbacks from Rust. Spans five files, which is why applied-ness cannot key off any single one -- see scripts/lib/v8-patch-apply.sh.

Copies rusty_v8.dll.lib to gn_out/obj/rusty_v8.lib after the ninja build. The shared_library GN target from 0006 never produces a plain static archive, but build.rs's print_link_flags() still requests `static=rusty_v8` unconditionally (MSVC resolves both the static and dylib -l kinds to the same NAME.lib naming convention regardless, so that directive did not need to change). Discovered building aarch64-pc-windows-msvc from a genuinely clean target dir for the first time: every prior Windows build here had silently relied on a stale rusty_v8.lib left over from 2026-07-24, predating 0006's shared-library refactor -- CI never exercises this path, since release.yml only fetches the already-built archive.
